title: Audit Android autosave lifecycle and cartridge storage
changes: Trace current fork cartridge saving and pinned upstream machine-state autosave across JNI, lifecycle, storage and restore boundaries.
validation: Inspected current Android frontend, JNI and engine, and pinned upstream engine, worker, card and lifecycle source; no ROM or runtime session used.
limitations: Static analysis does not establish device lifecycle timing, process-death recovery, storage durability or Android state compatibility. Autosave policy and implementation remain unapproved.
